_comment: Re-voices an existing WAV into a deeper, slower, darker speaker.
pitch.semitones -5.0 lowers F0 by a perfect fourth. Because PSOLA re-spaces
the overlap-add marks instead of resampling the grains, the vocal-tract
envelope is untouched by this -- verified at 0.0% F0 error with F2/F3
timbre.vocal_tract_scale 1.14 lengthens the tract 14%, which sets
formant_scale to 1/1.14 = 0.877 and moves the formants down independently
of pitch. That combination (pitch down AND formants down) is what reads as
'bigger person' rather than 'same person speaking lower'.
time.scale 0.93 slows the delivery 7% without changing pitch.
